stem: Who was the author of 'Banglar Mati, Banglar Jal', which was originally a protest song against the partition of Bengal by Lord Curzon in 1905, and for which the West Bengal Legislative Assembly recently passed a resolution as the new state anthem?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: ‘Banglar Mati, Banglar Jal’ is a Bengali patriotic song written by Rabindranath Tagore. Tagore wrote this song during the anti-Partition movement (1905) in connection with the Partition of Bengal. In the year 2023, the West Bengal Legislative Assembly passed a resolution to adopt this song as the State Song.
